title: Design System: Ali Nojoumi Model Shop

tape.displayName: Foam Blue (reserved; appears only in the tape picture)

display.purpose: Stencil capitals for section headings. Weight 800.

display-plate.purpose: Weight 900 for the hero name, figures, board names and the closing heading. Sizes run from clamp(2.9rem, 5.6vw, 5.4rem) for board names to clamp(6rem, min(13.2vw, 25svh), 13.5rem) for the name.

headline.purpose: The one statement paragraph. Archivo at width 84, sentence case, held to 17em.

title.purpose: Stencil names in the parts table. The same face at 1.3rem to 1.5rem sets the wordmark, job numbers and switch ratios.

lead.purpose: Opening paragraph of a section, max 34em. Weight 470 over the hero photo, 540 for a board summary.

body.purpose: Paragraphs at 30em to 40em. Lists and notes at 0.98rem.

label.purpose: Uppercase Archivo at width 82: sources on dimension lines, the line under a name, note terms. Never above a heading.

caption.purpose: Archivo at width 88, sentence case: print captions, caption slips, leader label, navigation links.

ruler.purpose: Tabular numbers on the two rulers. Decorative, hidden from assistive technology.

shadows.name: board
shadows.purpose: Every card board, together with a 6px card-edge lower border.

shadows.name: tape
shadows.purpose: Filter on each strip of masking tape.

shadows.name: slip
shadows.purpose: The leader label on the hero photo.

shadows.name: drawn-outline
shadows.purpose: Ghost button on the mat (0.35 alpha for the switch well; ink on card). A line, not a shadow.

shadows.name: pin
shadows.purpose: Numbered pin on the scale picture.

shadows.name: loupe-ring
shadows.purpose: The 184px loupe with its 5px yellow rim.

shadows.name: hero-text
shadows.value: text-shadow 0 2px 30px rgb(9 42 37 / 0.55) on the name; 0 1px 18px rgb(9 42 37 / 0.8) on the role
shadows.purpose: Keeps the hero words readable over the photo. Not used on text elsewhere.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.value: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)
motion.purpose: The one easing for interface transitions. GSAP entrances use expo.out.

motion.name: line-rise
motion.value: yPercent 108 to 0 from a line mask, 1.05s, stagger 0.09s, once at top 88%
motion.purpose: Headings and the statement (GSAP SplitText).

motion.name: hero-timeline
motion.value: photo scale 1.16 to 1 over 2.4s; name characters rise 1.15s, stagger 0.045s; print drops with back.out(1.5); tape scaleX 0 to 1; leader dot, line, label in turn
motion.purpose: First-screen entrance.

motion.name: small-rise
motion.value: y 30 and autoAlpha 0 to rest, 0.95s, stagger 0.07s, batched at top 92%
motion.purpose: Small items below the fold.

motion.name: card-set-down
motion.value: y 80, rotation -1.6deg, scale 0.97 to rest, 1.3s
motion.purpose: A board is set down on the mat.

motion.name: counter
motion.value: 1.8s power3.out; final value always in the markup
motion.purpose: Figures count up once.

motion.name: dimension-draw
motion.value: scaleX 0 to 1, 1.4s, origin left
motion.purpose: Dimension lines under figures.

motion.name: marker-scrub
motion.value: --mark 0% to 100%, scrub 0.5 between top 62% and top 34%
motion.purpose: Yellow marker across the key phrase.

motion.name: marker-hover
motion.value: background-size 0% to 100%, 0.5s
motion.purpose: Yellow marker behind a parts-table name.

motion.name: board-stack
motion.value: scale down 0.022 per board above, scrubbed; (min-width: 900px) and (min-height: 761px)
motion.purpose: Sticky project boards shrink as the next lands.

motion.name: photo-ease
motion.value: scale 1.06 to 1, 1.2s
motion.purpose: Board photo on hover.

motion.name: hero-drift
motion.value: x up to 13px, y up to 9px against the pointer, 1.2s power3.out; yPercent 7 on scroll
motion.purpose: Hero photo parallax. Mouse only.

motion.name: magnetic
motion.value: 0.32 of pointer offset; spring stiffness 220, damping 16, mass 0.5
motion.purpose: Primary actions drift toward a mouse pointer.

motion.name: print-tilt
motion.value: up to 4.5deg on each axis, perspective 900; spring stiffness 140, damping 18
motion.purpose: Prints tip toward a mouse pointer.

motion.name: switch-thumb
motion.value: shared layout spring, stiffness 420, damping 32
motion.purpose: Yellow thumb of the scale switch.

motion.name: pin-drop
motion.value: scale 0.2 and y -18 to rest; spring stiffness 380, damping 20; delay 0.25s plus 0.07s each
motion.purpose: Numbered pins land on the team picture.

motion.name: scale-zoom
motion.value: transform 0.9s to scale 2.15 on the chosen figure
motion.purpose: The scale picture zooms to a job.

motion.name: grid-loupe
motion.value: gaussian lens, radius about 190px, pointer follow 0.14, press 0.08
motion.purpose: WebGL grid swells and turns yellow under a mouse or pen.

motion.name: lenis
motion.value: lerp 0.11, anchor offset -56
motion.purpose: Smooth scroll, off under reduced motion.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce
motion.purpose: No GSAP, Lenis, magnetism, tilt, crosshair or lens; all content visible and still.

motion.name: failsafe
motion.value: 4s
motion.purpose: If the page script never starts, hidden entrance items are shown.

motion.name: gsap-transform-ownership
motion.value: no CSS translate, rotate or scale property on a GSAP-animated element
motion.purpose: Position with margins or put the fixed tilt on a child.

narrative.overview:
The page is the top of a model maker's bench. One green self-healing mat runs under everything, from the first screen to the footer, with a pale printed grid on it and a ruler along the top and left edges. On the mat sit things made by hand: white museum-card boards with a visible cut edge and four pin holes, and photo prints held down with blue masking tape. The pointer is a loupe laid on the mat: the grid swells under it and the ruler marks follow it.

Colour is flooded and then rationed. Green owns the whole ground. Card white is the only second surface. Cutter yellow is the one missing part, and each view gets one use of it: the action, the marked phrase, or the thing that is switched on. Type is stencil capitals for names and numbers, as on a parts crate, and a variable engineering sans for everything that has to be read. Figures are drawn the way a drawing sheet draws them, with a dimension line and a source on the line.

Depth is real light on real objects. Boards and prints cast a soft shadow down and to the right, as from a window at the upper left, and a board shows its thickness along its lower edge. Every pointer effect is an enrichment: the page is complete with no hover, no script, no WebGL and reduced motion.
keyCharacteristics: One green mat under every section; no section changes the ground.
White cut-card boards with square corners, a thick lower edge and four pin holes.
Yellow is the one part per view: the action, the marked phrase, or the active state.
Stencil capitals for names and numbers; a width-axis sans for reading.
Photo prints with a white border, grain, a slight tilt and masking tape.
Rulers on the top and left edges that carry the navigation and the pointer.
Soft daylight shadows that fall down and to the right.

rules.name: The One Part Rule
rules.body: Yellow is reserved for the one missing part in each view, the primary action, the marked phrase and the active state. If two unrelated things in one view are yellow at rest, one of them is wrong. The ruler marks and the light under the pointer are instruments and do not count.

rules.name: The One Mat Rule
rules.body: The ground is mat green everywhere. A section changes by what is laid on the mat (a board, a print, a table of ruled rows), never by a new ground colour.

rules.name: The Two Surfaces Rule
rules.body: Text sits on the mat in card white, mint or yellow, or on card in graphite. Mint never appears on card and graphite never appears on the mat.

rules.name: The Stencil Rule
rules.body: The stencil sets names and numbers only, in capitals, at 1.3rem and above. It never sets a sentence, a paragraph, a caption or a button.

rules.name: The Width Axis Rule
rules.body: Small text gets narrower before it gets smaller: width 82 for labels, 84 for the statement, 88 to 90 for captions and list labels, normal width for paragraphs. Do not add a third family or a mono.

rules.name: The Under, Not Over Rule
rules.body: A label sits under the name it describes, or on a dimension line. No label sits above a heading to name the section.

rules.name: The Borrowed L Rule
rules.body: Keep Shop Display first in the display stack. Without it the stencil L breaks the name.

rules.name: The Window Light Rule
rules.body: Every cast shadow falls down and to the right, uses a negative spread, and is tinted dark mat green. No shadow is centred, black, or without blur.

rules.name: The Board Thickness Rule
rules.body: A thing that has thickness shows it on its lower edge only: 6px for a board, 4px for a button, 3px for the switch thumb. The edge is never drawn on a side.

dos: Do keep the ground mat green in every section and change sections by what is laid on the mat.
Do give each view one yellow thing: the action, the marked phrase or the active state. Put ink on it.
Do cut boards square, with the 6px card-edge lower border, the board shadow and four pin holes.
Do set names and numbers in stencil capitals at weight 800 or 900, and everything that is read as a sentence in Archivo.
Do narrow small text with the width axis (82 to 90) before reducing its size.
Do present a photo as a print: white border, caption below, grain, tape, a tilt of 1.2 to 4 degrees and the print shadow.
Do throw every shadow down and to the right with a negative spread and a dark-green tint.
Do draw a figure with a dimension line and put its source on the line.
Do keep all content present with no hover, no script, no WebGL and reduced motion.
Do keep targets at 44px or more, and buttons at 54px.
donts: Don't use yellow as text on card, as a section ground, or for two unrelated things in one view.
Don't introduce a second ground colour, a dark section, or a cream page.
Don't round a board, a button or the switch. Curves belong to prints (1px), slips (2px) and round objects.
Don't set a sentence, a caption or a button in the stencil, and don't use it below 1.3rem.
Don't place a small label above a heading to name the section.
Don't use a centred, black or zero-blur shadow, or put a shadow on a ruled row.
Don't draw a thick edge on the side of a board or a row. Thickness shows on the lower edge only.
Don't put mint on card or graphite on the mat.
Don't set the CSS `translate`, `rotate` or `scale` properties on an element GSAP animates.
Don't assign a role to foam blue or mat lift without a new decision. Blue is the tape picture and nothing else.
Don't add a mono or a third type family.
